When you enter a Rage, you gain Fury of Souls for [1] turns. The effect ends if your Rage ends.

Triggers at most once per combat.

The spirits guide your hand. You gain a bonus to melee weapon Attack Rolls and deal an extra[1] with melee weapons. But their presence drains your mind: at the end of your turn, you take[2].

Their strength depends on your Proficiency Bonus.

This finely crafted ring, shaped like a mythical rhinoceros, immediately caught your attention. Initially, nothing noteworthy happened when you first wore it. However, the moment you flew into a rage, you became host to the tormented souls of the past trapped within this artifact; their collective presence attempting to assail your sanity. It dawns on you that this is a profoundly ancient item, once used by a tribe for purposes as dark as slave hunting. Now, you must find a way to channel and control this daunting energy.
